title: Between Rigor and Reality: How AI Safety Benchmark Developers Understand Benchmark Use and Maintenance
abstract: arXiv:2611.18930v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Safety benchmarks are cited as the primary tool to understand the risks posed by generative AI (GenAI) systems, yet growing evidence suggests they often fail to meet the needs of real-world safety evaluation. We present findings from five interviews with AI safety benchmark developers in academia and industry. We find a disconnect between perceptions of the intended usefulness of safety benchmarks and their practical usefulness in safety evaluations of deployed systems. Our participants offered perspectives on two challenges contributing to this disconnect: (1) the difficulty of achieving inter-rater reliability on safety constructs, and (2) a lack of clarity regarding how to address persistent threats to external validity. Based on our analysis, we argue that safety benchmarks must not only be grounded in deployment contexts, but actively integrated with them. translated_title: 在严谨与现实之间：AI安全基准测试开发者如何理解基准的使用与维护
translated_abstract: 安全基准测试被公认为是理解生成式AI（GenAI）系统所带来风险的主要工具，然而越来越多的证据表明，这些基准往往无法满足现实世界安全评估的需求。我们展示了对学术界和产业界的AI安全基准测试开发者进行的五次访谈的结果。我们发现，人们对安全基准测试预期有用性的认知与其在已部署系统安全评估中的实际有用性之间存在脱节。我们的受访者对造成这种脱节的两个挑战提出了看法：（1）在安全概念上难以实现评分者间信度，以及（2）在如何应对外部效度面临的持续性威胁方面缺乏明确的认识。基于我们的分析，我们认为安全基准测试不仅要立足于部署环境，还必须与部署环境主动融合。为促进这一目标的实现，我们概述了实现更透明沟通的途径。
tldr: 通过对学术界和产业界的AI安全基准测试开发者进行访谈，本研究揭示了安全基准测试的预期用途与实际部署系统安全评估之间的脱节，指出评分者间信度难以实现和外部效度威胁应对不清这两大挑战，并提出基准测试必须与部署环境主动融合。
en_tdlr: Based on interviews with AI safety benchmark developers in academia and industry, this paper reveals a disconnect between the intended usefulness of safety benchmarks and their practical value in evaluating deployed systems, identifies challenges in inter-rater reliability and external validity, and argues that benchmarks must be actively integrated with deployment contexts.
